rollback.sql: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS model_calibrations CASCADE;

changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE model_profiles ADD COLUMN profile JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, ADD COLUMN calibration_id BIGINT REFERENCES model_calibrations(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, ADD COLUMN calibration_key_hash TEXT, ADD COLUMN sync_revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
CREATE INDEX idx_model_profiles_calibration ON model_profiles (calibration_id) WHERE calibration_id IS NOT NULL;
